comments.body:
Quest name: Double humped camel (Chrono Quest - 14th Century)
Quest location: Aden Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r6 Ecological Research, r8 Biology, CHN(Chinese)
Pre-requisite discovery: Xanadu discovery (from "The promised future" quest) + Dromedary discovery (from "Humpback animal map")
Additional note: "Aftermath" part of Xanadu/Great Adventurer questchain
